## Running Games:
Minecraft: Xbox One Edition - 60 FPS
Rocket League - 60 FPS
Sonic Mania - 60 FPS

These are all confirmed to be running games, everything else is unconfirmed

## Installation
Sideload Utsuro.ipa and open the app. Import your Xbox One Dump, enable JIT and get to playing!
